deploy-bot: starting staged deploy of tagged release v2.1.4-signed -> production
deploy-bot: commit: a1b2c3d9ef | image: registry.redwood/prod:v2.1.4-signed | change-window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
deploy-bot: rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (2m waits between stages)
release-manager: ack on my end, tag verified and signed :white_check_mark:
maria: holding - running quick staging smoke (sanity + sample prompt)
deploy-bot: stage 1 (5%) complete - all instances healthy
kevin: seeing slight spike in 5xx from model-infer in us-west-2, 0.8% -> 1.6% over last 2 minutes
kevin: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-20T02:15:12Z] model-infer us-west-2 POST /v1/generate 500 x3 trace=abc123
[2026-03-20T02:15:13Z] redis kvcache miss spike
```
sre-oncall: @maria @kevin can you confirm if this is related to kv cache warmup or actual model failure? pause rollout?
maria: I see increased latencies on staging when input seq > 1024, trying a repro now
release-manager: pause rollout. hold next stages. we should prepare to pin back to v2.1.3 if degradation continues
deploy-bot: rollout paused by release-manager - next stages prevented
ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260320-1234 assigned -> SRE team, severity P2
kevin: running a targeted canary test to repro (same payload as production 5xx)
maria: repro confirmed on one model shard in us-west-2; raising PR to revert the offending quantization flag
release-manager: decision: rollback to last stable tag v2.1.3 across prod. notify customers if ETA >10m
release-manager: command to promote previous tag: ```
# promote previous image
kubectl set image deployment/model-prod model=registry.redwood/prod:v2.1.3 --namespace=prod-us-west-2
# then repeat for other regions
```
deploy-bot: initiating rollback: promoting v2.1.3 -> production. rollback commit: fff111aa | est time: ~4m
deploy-bot: rolling back us-west-2 first
kevin: monitoring metrics and traces, tailing logs
sre-oncall: will keep traffic routed to warm instances during rollback
deploy-bot: rollback step complete: us-west-2 on v2.1.3, sanity checks green
deploy-bot: rollback complete: production now on v2.1.3 in all regions; health checks PASS
release-manager: thanks team. opening follow-up ticket for root cause + revert PR review (TICKET-4567)
maria: will post the PR and a short postmortem to #postmortems once we triage
ops-bot: closing incident INC-20260320-1234 (resolved by rollback)
release-manager: thread closed, will schedule a controlled re-release after fixes :calendar:
